decisions.reason: This navigation and observation camera remains tightly aligned with the firm's proven optical flight heritage and should continue to benefit from steady institutional and spacecraft demand.
The modular camera line is central to the firm's core business and its several models improve mission fit and make it especially valuable to retain.

The miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR sensor fits the firm's move toward compact advanced sensors, but its more limited website prominence still suggests somewhat higher commercialization risk than the main camera lines.
The radiation-hard camera line is very close to the firm's established space imaging strengths and its dedicated product presentation indicates clear strategic commitment.

The asteroid navigation and imaging camera builds logically on the firm's heritage, but as a newer and more specialized product with lower website prominence it carries a higher risk of reprioritization than the core platforms.
